channel.title: RuleReceipt blog
channel.description: Checking what AI coding agents actually did, against your written rules.

item.title: Did your agent ignore your rule, or never see it?
item.description: A rule can break two ways: the agent read it and ignored it, or the rule never loaded at all. Those are different problems, and RuleReceipt tells them apart. A break on a rule that never loaded is shown, but not counted as a violation.

item.title: I wrote a rule. My agent broke it anyway.
item.description: I had 'never push without asking' in my CLAUDE.md. Claude pushed to main, and I only noticed later. So I built a demo session with three mistakes agents really make, and ran RuleReceipt on it. Here's what a receipt of the session shows, and what it honestly can't.
